# DevTaskHub

> DevTaskHub (devtaskhub.com) is a web and mobile development studio in Thessaloniki, Greece, founded and run by full-stack developer Theocharis Siozos (Θεοχάρης Σιώζος). It builds websites, e-shops, web apps, iOS and Android apps, AI chatbots and SEO for businesses across Greece and abroad. Greek name of the main service: «Κατασκευή ιστοσελίδων και εφαρμογών στη Θεσσαλονίκη».

## About
- Name: DevTaskHub
- Founder: Theocharis Siozos (Θεοχάρης Σιώζος), full-stack developer
- Based in: Thessaloniki (Θεσσαλονίκη), Central Macedonia, Greece. Works remotely with clients across Greece and abroad.
- Languages: Greek, English, French
- Phone: +30 697 198 2563
- Email: info@devtaskhub.com
- How it works: free quote and timeline first, design shown before any code, progress shown at every step, support after launch.
- Typical timelines (from the site FAQ): presentation website 2 to 4 weeks, e-shop 4 to 8 weeks, custom apps depend on the project.
- Prices: quoted per project, free and before any work starts. No fixed price list.

## Services (Υπηρεσίες)
- [Website development, Κατασκευή ιστοσελίδων](https://devtaskhub.com/services/web-development): fast, mobile-first, SEO-ready websites and web apps.
- [Mobile app development, Κατασκευή εφαρμογών κινητών iOS και Android](https://devtaskhub.com/services/mobile-app-development): iOS and Android apps, published on the App Store and Google Play.
- [E-shop development, Κατασκευή e-shop](https://devtaskhub.com/services/ecommerce-development): online stores and booking platforms with online payments and an admin panel.
- [AI chatbots and agents](https://devtaskhub.com/services/chatbots-ai-agents): chatbots for websites, Messenger and WhatsApp, for support, leads and bookings.
- [AI integration, Ενσωμάτωση AI](https://devtaskhub.com/services/ai-integration-applications): GPT and NLP features, recommendations, automation and data analysis inside apps.
- [SEO, Βελτιστοποίηση ιστοσελίδων](https://devtaskhub.com/services/seo-website-optimization): technical SEO, speed, structured data and content, for Google and AI search.
- [Social media management, Διαχείριση social media](https://devtaskhub.com/services/social-media-management): strategy, content, scheduling, community and analytics.
- [UX/UI design](https://devtaskhub.com/services/ux-ui-design): wireframes, prototypes and interface design for web and mobile.
- [Databases and cloud, Βάσεις δεδομένων και cloud](https://devtaskhub.com/services/database-cloud-infrastructure): secure, scalable data and cloud setups with backups.
- [Video and animation, Βίντεο και animation](https://devtaskhub.com/services/video-animation-production): promotional, educational and product video, motion graphics.
- [Game development](https://devtaskhub.com/services/game-development): games for web, desktop and mobile.

## Selected work
Full list: https://devtaskhub.com/portfolio

### Mobile apps
- [LifeMuseum](https://lifemuseumapp.com/): iOS and Android app that turns the moments of your life into museum exhibits and your year into a film. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lifemuseum/id6799032000), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lifemuseum.app).
- [T-Parking](https://t-parking.com/): the first app in Greece that shows free on-street parking spots in real time. Free, iOS and Android. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/gr/app/t-parking/id6756634872), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tparking.app).
- [GetFit SKG](https://getfitskg.com/): gym app for members, training programs, bookings and payments. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/getfit-skg/id6753928093).

### Web apps and platforms
- [Hournook](https://www.hournook.com/): online booking SaaS for professionals. A booking page in minutes, in 15 languages.
- [Lumora Predictions](https://lumorapredictions.com/): prediction web app (tarot, coffee cup, crystal ball) with accounts, online payments and an admin panel.
- [Leonidion Houses](https://www.leonidionhouses.com/): booking platform for 6 properties with online payments and an admin panel.
- [Online Parent & Teen Clinic](https://onlineparentteenclinic.com/): telemedicine platform with online appointments.

### Websites
- [KLINARITI](https://klinariti.com/): website for an astrologer and clinical psychologist, with session booking.
- [Advanced Derma](https://advanced-derma.com/): dermatology clinic in Athens and Piraeus, with online appointments.
- [Architecture and construction office](https://in-mavridis.gr/): company website with services and project portfolio, built for SEO.
- [HydrogenLife](https://hydrogenlife.eu/): wellness center with services and online bookings.
- [LifeMuseum website](https://lifemuseumapp.com/): official app website in six languages.
- HANDSTUFF: e-shop for handmade leather bags.
